title: Toyota Highlander
detailHtml:
Our Toyota Highlander is a 3-row SUV that comfortably seats up to 7 passengers with room left over for luggage — a solid choice for larger groups, families traveling with bags, or a small corporate group heading to the airport together.

Book it for airport transfers, long-distance trips, or any time you need more room than a standard sedan without splitting the group into two vehicles.

images.alt: Gray Toyota Highlander SUV, part of the US Limo and Taxi fleet

title: Honda CR-V
detailHtml:
Our Honda CR-V is a compact SUV that seats up to 5 passengers with a roomy cargo area for luggage — a comfortable option for couples, small families, or business travelers who want more space than a sedan.

Book it for airport transfers, local trips, or long-distance travel.

title: Chrysler Pacifica
detailHtml:
Our Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid is a minivan that seats up to 7 passengers with sliding doors and plenty of luggage room — a comfortable, easy-access choice for families, groups, or wedding guest transportation.

Book it for airport transfers, group outings, or any trip where easy in-and-out access matters.

detailHtml:

Book it for airport transfers, group outings, or any trip where you'd rather not split up.

title: Kia EV9
detailHtml:
Our Kia EV9 is an all-electric 3-row SUV that seats up to 6 passengers — a quiet, zero-emission ride with room for a small group and their luggage.

Book it for airport transfers, corporate travel, or any trip where you'd like a newer, all-electric vehicle.

title: Cadillac Escalade IQ
detailHtml:
Our Cadillac Escalade IQ is a full-size, all-electric SUV that seats up to 7 passengers in a premium, quiet cabin — a polished choice for corporate travel, VIP transport, or anyone who wants a more upscale, all-electric ride to the airport.

Book it for airport transfers, business travel, or wedding guest transportation.
